headlines.title: Share Buyback Could Be A Big Deal For Booking Holdings Stock
headlines.summary: Booking Holdings announced a new global Booking Partner Division, expanded trip-wide booking features through Vayo, and issued multi-year euro-denominated senior notes totaling €3.55b with staggered maturities from 2029 to 2038. The combination of a scaled B2B travel platform, AI-driven trip management via Vayo, and long-dated euro funding reshapes how Booking Holdings matches its balance sheet to a broad, multi-brand operating model.

headlines.title: Booking Holdings (BKNG) Says It Plans To Acquire An Australian Restaurant Tech Firm
headlines.summary: Booking Holdings (NasdaqGS:BKNG) brand OpenTable has agreed to acquire Australian restaurant technology company me&u, according to a new proposal. me&u brings an AI-native ordering and payments platform focused on restaurant operations and guest engagement in Australia and other markets. OpenTable plans to combine its reservation and guest experience tools with me&u's AI-driven system to build a more connected restaurant product suite.

headlines.title: Booking Holdings Inc. to Present at the Nasdaq 55th Investor Conference
headlines.summary: Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) today announced that Chief Financial Officer Ewout Steenbergen will speak at the Nasdaq 55th Investor Conference, held in association with Morgan Stanley in London, on December 8, beginning at 6:30 am ET / 11:30 am GMT. A live audio cast of the presentation will be available to the public at https://ir.bookingholdings.com/events. A replay will be available approximately 24 hours later and will remain available for 12 months.

description: Booking Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides online and traditional travel and restaurant reservations and related services in the United States, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company operates Booking.com, which offers online accommodation reservations; and Priceline, which provides discount travel reservations services, as well as online accommodation, flight, rental car reservation services, vacation packages, cruises, activity, and affiliate programs. It also operates Agoda that offers online accommodation reservation, flight, ground transportation, and attractions. In addition, the company operates KAYAK, an online meta-search service that allows consumers to search and compare travel itineraries and prices; and OpenTable for booking online restaurant reservations, as well as reservation management services to restaurants. Further, it offers travel-related insurance products, payment facilitation, and restaurant management services to consumers, travel service providers, and restaurants; and advertising services. The company was formerly known as The Priceline Group Inc. and changed its name to Booking Holdings Inc. in February 2018. Booking Holdings Inc. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut.
